In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''duel''' occurred aboard a [[Mining Explorer]] belonging to the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] between [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Skywalker managed to defeat Tagge and escape back to the Rebel Alliance in order to warn them of Tagge's plans.
